classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory national-security determination that legally authorizes use of the cited funds; later administration merely implements that determination.

classifications.rationale: Executive agencies are assigned implementation, expenditure, and reimbursement-coordination responsibilities, with the particular actions and amounts left to later requests, interagency agreement, and budget approval.
classifications.evidence: are authorized and directed to take such action and make such expenditures as may be necessary

classifications.rationale: The first sentence expresses a nonbinding desire, while the second requests that an official transmit statutory notices to congressional committee chairs; neither governs agencies in a legally consequential way.
classifications.evidence: is requested on my behalf to give appropriate notices
